Groove data allocation, headers, joins, volume management, and verification APIs.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_groove_data` interface for a groove data store that manages bounded-size objects across groove volumes and superblocks. It declares the shared-memory layout, the local join state, sizeclass configuration, and the packed [`fd_groove_data_hdr`](<#fd_groove_data_hdr>) format used to store object metadata in each data block. The file also provides inline helpers to compute alignment, footprint, object headers, sizeclass selection, allocation bounds, and access to join state fields such as `shdata`, `volume0`, `volume1`, and `cgroup_hint`. It declares the main lifecycle and object management functions, including [`fd_groove_data_new`](<#fd_groove_data_new>), [`fd_groove_data_join`](<#fd_groove_data_join>), [`fd_groove_data_leave`](<#fd_groove_data_leave>), [`fd_groove_data_delete`](<#fd_groove_data_delete>), [`fd_groove_data_alloc`](<#fd_groove_data_alloc>), [`fd_groove_data_free`](<#fd_groove_data_free>), and the verify functions for data and volumes.
